newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse trade mixed to higher.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse trade mixed to higher.

text.p: 1141 GMT - German shares end bourse trade generally unchanged but market gets boost in late trade from strengthening dollar against mark. Volumes still muted ahead of U.S. producer prices data and jobless claims due later. Stronger German debt and futures continue to underpin DAX.
* DAX index ends up 3.52 points at 2,570.32
* September DAX future up 3.0 points at 2,572.5.
* Deutsche Bank ends higher after UBS confirms its upgrade on the Frankfurt bank from hold to buy.
* BMW ends lower but off low after CEO forecasts 10 pct earnings growth, dissapoints some bullish expectations.
